list.title: Boards
list.subtitle: Infinite whiteboards for your team. Everyone in the workspace can open and edit them.
list.emptyHint: Sketch, plan and share an idea on an infinite canvas.
list.createError: Couldn’t create the board. Try again.

share.title: Share by link
share.hint: Anyone with the link can view this board, without editing it.

editor.name: Board name
editor.renameError: Couldn't rename. Press Enter to try again.
editor.tooLarge: This board is over {mb} MB, usually because of images. Remove or shrink some images to keep saving.
editor.conflictDeleted: This board changed somewhere else: something you edited was deleted there, or you deleted something that was edited there. Everything else is already combined.
editor.conflictDeletedBy: {name} changed this board: something you edited was deleted on their side, or you deleted something they edited. Everything else is already combined.
editor.draftFound: There are changes from your last visit that didn't get saved.
editor.remoteAppliedAnon: Updated with changes from someone else
editor.remoteChanged: {name} changed this board. Your changes here aren't saved yet.
editor.remoteChangedAnon: Someone else changed this board. Your changes here aren't saved yet.

retro.name: Retrospective
retro.description: What went well, what to improve and the actions to take.
retro.title: Sprint retro
retro.hint: Add a note to each column, then vote on what to tackle first.

brainstorm.name: Brainstorm
brainstorm.description: A central topic with room for ideas around it.
brainstorm.title: Brainstorm

userFlow.name: User flow
userFlow.description: Screens and decisions from the first visit to the goal.
userFlow.title: User flow

kanban.name: Kanban
kanban.description: Backlog, to do, in progress and done.
kanban.title: Kanban

roadmap.name: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Initiatives by team across four quarters.
roadmap.title: Roadmap

history.title: Version history
history.hint: A version is saved every hour while the board is being edited, for 30 days. Restoring opens it as a new board and leaves this one as it is.
history.empty: No versions yet. The first one is saved after an hour of editing.

comments.placeHint: Click on the board to place a comment. Esc cancels.
comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comments yet. Use “Add comment” and click anywhere on the board.
comments.placeholder: Write a comment. Type @ to mention someone.
comments.pinLabel: Comment {n}, {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}
comments.replies: {count, plural, =0 {no replies} one {# reply} other {# replies}}

stickies.title: Sticky notes
stickies.selected: {count, plural, one {# sticky selected} other {# stickies selected}}
stickies.bulkHint: One sticky per line, up to {max}. Words with # become tags.
stickies.bulkPlaceholder:
Faster onboarding #ux
Fix the export bug #bug
stickies.bulkAdd: {count, plural, =0 {Add stickies} one {Add # sticky} other {Add # stickies}}

track.title: Turn into Track issues
track.selectHint: Select the stickies you want to turn into issues, then open this again.
track.ready: {count, plural, one {# sticky will become an issue.} other {# stickies will become issues.}}
track.someLinked: {count, plural, one {# already has an issue.} other {# already have an issue.}}
track.allLinked: Everything selected already has an issue.
track.noProjects: There are no Track teams in this workspace yet.
track.created: Created {list}. Their status shows under each sticky.
track.error: Couldn’t create the issues. Try again.

workshop.title: Workshop tools
workshop.noTimer: No timer running. Someone who can edit the board can start one.
workshop.votingHint: Everyone gets the same number of votes to spread across the stickies. Votes stay hidden until you close the session.
workshop.votingOpen: Voting is open. You have {left} of {total} votes left: click + on a sticky.
workshop.voters: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has voted yet.} one {# person has voted.} other {# people have voted.}}
workshop.results: {count, plural, =0 {Results} one {Results from # person} other {Results from # people}}
workshop.voteFor: {count, plural, =0 {Vote for this} one {Your vote: #. Add another} other {Your votes: #. Add another}}
workshop.error: Couldn’t update the workshop. Try again.

access.title: Who can open this board

modes.workspaceHint: Every member can open and edit it.
modes.restrictedHint: Only invited people, the person who created it and workspace admins can open it.

access.guestHint: Anyone with this link can edit the board without an account. Turn it off to cut access.
access.aloneHint: You’re the only person in this workspace for now. Add your team to invite them to this board.
access.allInvited: Everyone in the workspace is already invited.
